@@U02461@@
with a look around at this charming assembly. Ah, and wouldn't you know, there, there she is, woman, always out front, always when there’s something tasty to be nibbled or some sight to be stared at. But let me assure you, not being a shriveled prune as yet, I still know a beautiful woman when I see one! And since today it’s to be had for the asking, I think I just might go a-wooing. Ah, but with all this noise, this crowd, who can make himself heard? I'll have to resort to a bit of pantomime. There are some things hands, feet, and gestures just can’t say, and so I'll fall back on my arts for a ruder prank. This gold is a metal can be molded into any shape. Tl treat it like wet clay and see what I get.

@@U02463@@
What’s that skinny fool up to? How can a walking skeleton be funny? Look at him there, kneading that gold like dough, soft and pliable, squeezing, pulling, pummeling, pounding— and still it’s shapeless. But there, look, he’s turning to those women, and they scream and screech in disgust, trying to escape. I fear this rogue is well versed in evil. He appears to delight the more he offends decency. I can’t just stand here
translation:
@@U02461@@
环顾四周这个迷人的集会。啊，你难道不知道吗，她就在那儿，女人，总是在前面，总是在有好吃的东西可以吃或者有什么东西可以盯着看的时候。但我向你保证，我还不是一颗枯萎的李子，当我看到一个美丽的女人时，我仍然知道一个美丽的女人！既然今天它是可以提出要求的，我想我可能会去求爱。啊，但是这么多噪音，这么多人群，谁能听到自己的声音呢？我将不得不诉诸一些哑剧。有些事情是手、脚和手势无法表达的，所以我会依靠我的艺术来进行一个更粗鲁的恶作剧。这种黄金是一种可以塑造成任何形状的金属。我把它当作湿粘土一样对待，看看我会得到什么。

@@U02463@@
那个瘦弱的傻瓜在做什么？行走的骷髅怎么可能有趣呢？你看他在那里，揉着那金子，像面团一样，柔软而有弹性，挤、拉、捶、捶——但它仍然没有形状。但你看，他正转向那些女人，她们厌恶地尖叫着，试图逃跑。恐怕这个盗贼深谙邪恶之道。他似乎越是违背礼仪，越是感到高兴。我不能只是站在这里
